neighbours.label: ' in' of 'in advance' after a span of time (months in advance)
fire: The forecast service predicts heat waves several weeks in advance of their arrival.
Please book your seats at least three days in advance.
Farmers must order the seed six months in advance.
The warning was issued about forty minutes in advance of the tornado.
Guests were asked to confirm their dietary needs two weeks in advance.
The trains were sold out, so we bought tickets a month in advance.
Doctors may detect the disease years in advance of any symptoms.
The rota is published a full quarter in advance.
quiet: The forecast service predicts heat waves several weeks ahead of their arrival.
Please book your seats at least three days beforehand.
Farmers must order the seed six months before planting.
The warning was issued about forty minutes before the tornado.
Guests were asked to confirm their dietary needs two weeks early.
The trains were sold out, so we bought tickets a month ahead.
Doctors may detect the disease years before any symptoms appear.
The rota is published a full quarter ahead of time.

notes: ' in' x9 of the top 32, almost all 'X days/months in advance'. Near misses keep the time span and the meaning but say 'ahead of time' / 'beforehand'.
